entries.en: Ugh, it's like I got ants crawlin' all over. Just wanna rip this mask off.
entries.ro: Ugh, parcă mi-au intrat furnici peste tot. Vreau doar să-mi smulg măcar masca asta.

entries.en: Told you not to take that new scopbooster at work.
entries.ro: Ți-am zis să nu iei scopbooster-ul ăla nou la muncă.
